mapper.select: select base_key as baseKey, source_table_id as sourceTableId, source_table_name as sourceTableName, source_revision as sourceRevision, field_count as fieldCount, record_count as recordCount, case source_table_id when 'tblHDwb0OdfcH1Ib' then 'app_eldercare_customer_profile' when 'tblA33x9gGWM1b51' then 'app_customer_income_feishu' when 'tblCShsrcNLI5mz2' then 'app_activity_plan_feishu' when 'tbla1l9EkUS29VcB' then 'app_long_care_followup' when 'tblmX6fzPDdcWrxT' then 'app_medical_care_followup' when 'tblDmz6MlXt1XQGG' then 'app_eldercare_monthly_income' when 'tblRKs34PUprry5y' then 'app_consultant_feishu' when 'tblIJE3sVGcl0eBh' then 'app_satisfaction_survey' when 'tblXVuYCto8OOmAz' then 'app_travel_customer_profile' when 'tblZWWWFyzY1hAyb' then 'app_travel_order_profile' when 'tblMs6nJkL7sfIB9' then 'app_travel_settlement' when 'tblxlsfbE4psjcHr' then 'app_travel_base' when 'tbllqcoAGXIQ3HXW' then 'app_travel_host_schedule' when 'tblFLB8NaIMkj1jY' then 'app_travel_host' when 'tbl2q1qmQae6Pyen' then 'app_travel_media_account' end as structuredTable, (select count(*) from app_feishu_migration_record r where r.source_table_id = t.source_table_id and r.merge_status = 'merged') as mergedCount, imported_at as importedAt from app_feishu_migration_table t order by field(base_key, 'travel', 'eldercare'), migration_table_id

select rel.source_field_id as sourceFieldId, f.source_field_name as sourceFieldName, rel.target_source_table_id as targetSourceTableId, target.source_table_name as targetSourceTableName, rel.target_source_record_id as targetSourceRecordId, rel.target_business_table as targetBusinessTable, rel.target_business_id as targetBusinessId, rel.display_text as displayText, rel.relation_status as relationStatus, rel.relation_message as relationMessage from app_feishu_business_relation rel left join app_feishu_migration_field f on f.source_table_id = rel.source_table_id and f.source_field_id = rel.source_field_id left join app_feishu_migration_table target on target.source_table_id = rel.target_source_table_id where rel.source_table_id = #{sourceTableId} and rel.source_record_id = #{sourceRecordId} order by f.migration_field_id, rel.relation_order

select source_field_id as sourceFieldId, source_field_name as sourceFieldName, source_field_type as sourceFieldType, source_ui_type as sourceUiType, is_primary as isPrimary from app_feishu_migration_field where source_table_id = #{sourceTableId} order by migration_field_id
select source_field_name from app_feishu_migration_field where source_table_id = #{sourceTableId} and (source_field_type = 13 or source_field_name regexp '身份证|地址')
